planets.name: TOI-521 b
planets.description: Transiting planet of TOI-521 with a 1.54-day year, found in 2025.

text.card: TOI-521 b was found in 2025 by TESS as it crossed its star.
text.introduction: It is the only planet known around TOI-521. Its orbit and size follow Lacedelli et al. 2026's fit, the archive's default.
